transcript: Khatoon, 28 saal. Saraf, follow up. Celix aayein. Fesli dard hai. Koi raat se koi raha. Xytoffat nahi. Bukhar nahi. Khansi nahi. Paani saran se allergy hai. Is liye Augmentin nahi deni. Zyrtec aadhi goli raat ko, 10 din. Ek mahine baad dikhayein.

medications.name: Zyrtec
medications.instructions: continue current medication, return in 1 month
